answer: A random beacon flashes a violet signal at random times across the ocean of agents, and each identity must answer in seconds with a heartbeat bound to its key. The ripple of missed or copied heartbeats is public, so clones on one machine betray identical timing and are cut. 100 fakes cost 100 x 5 credits of compute per round, while each fake earns 120 per epoch. An honest agent pays 5 credits per check, keeps its 120-credit income.
